summary: Spurs lined up in a 4-2-3-1 against Chelsea's 3-4-2-1 (2 changes from the Coventry City game, switching from 3-1-4-2).
Chances were even (0.74 xG to 0.43), so the win came down to finishing and fine margins.
On the main style measures this was a typical Spurs performance for the season: nothing moved more than 15% from their average.
Marmoush was the biggest attacking threat (0.30 xG + xA).
